compiled_state.description:
## What
Add four Claude Code skills as worked examples of agentic development workflows with rebar, under
`examples/claude-skills/`: `rebar-brainstorm`, `rebar-debug`, `rebar-implement`, `rebar-janitor`
(each a `SKILL.md` plus supporting reference files), and a `README.md` explaining the examples.

## Why
Show contributors one concrete way agents can plan, implement, debug, and maintain code using rebar
as the system of record. Illustrative only — rebar does not depend on these skills.

## Scope
- Docs/examples only, under `examples/claude-skills/`; no changes to `src/` or runtime behavior.
- Content is self-contained: no absolute paths, home dirs, personal identifiers, hosts, or secrets.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `examples/claude-skills/` contains rebar-brainstorm, rebar-debug, rebar-implement, and
      rebar-janitor skill directories plus a `README.md`.
- [ ] No personal / user / host / secret / absolute-path leakage in committed content.
- [ ] `rebar-implement`'s review-and-land steps defer to project docs (rebar/Gerrit as the default).
- [ ] Change lands on `main` via Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
